k4.disputed_point: Size of the after-hours drop on Oct 1, 2026: the key says about 3%, Answer A says 8.5% (Reuters).
k4.why: The after-hours move was reported at different sizes depending on the time of the snapshot. Benzinga Pro showed -4.17% at $33.64, one aggregator showed about -5.5% at $33.20, and TIKR (updated Oct 2) said about 9%. Reuters, per Answer A, said 8.5%. I could not open the Reuters page, so that figure is unconfirmed. The next-day regular session is better documented. The vermoegenszentrum page says Nike fell 5.28% to $33.29 on Oct 2 from a $35.15 close. The intraday low was $31.97, volume was about 57.6M against a 27.55M average, and the 52-week range was $31.97–$74.78. The key's Oct 2 figures match that page. The key's "about 3%" after-hours figure is one early snapshot, and an after-hours drop of 3% to 9% is defensible depending on timing. I did not verify the key's aggregator close of about $33.87 (-3.6%).
k4.corrected_answer: Shares fell in extended trading on Oct 1, 2026. Early reports showed about 3-4%, and later reports showed roughly 5-9% (Reuters reported 8.5%, TIKR about 9%). On Oct 2 they fell as much as 5.3% intraday to about $33.29, after a prior close of $35.15 (low $31.97). Volume was roughly 57.6M shares, about twice the average. One aggregator shows an Oct 2 close of about $33.87 (-3.6%), so the exact close is uncertain. The shares were near the bottom of a 52-week range of $31.97–$74.78.
